svg.title: Facade
svg.desc: Facade. Give a complex subsystem one simple entry point, so callers make one call instead of orchestrating many classes. Step 1, Every caller orchestrates: Both controllers call all five classes in order: the same code twice, so a new size means two edits. Step 2, One entry point: ImageUploader.upload(file) owns the sequence. Controllers call only it; the classes stay public. Step 3, One call, eleven behind it: upload('cat.jpg') makes 1 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 1 = 11 subsystem calls, and three URLs come back. Step 4, What it is and isn't: It simplifies: it adds no behaviour (Decorator) and converts no interface (Adapter). Keep it thin.

g.text: Both controllers call all five classes in order: the same code twice, so a new size means two edits.

It simplifies: it adds no behaviour (Decorator) and converts no interface (Adapter). Keep it thin.
